description: Searches the free browser games listed on Foundplay, made by independent creators, many of them with AI tools. Matches the query against each game's title, one-line description and genres. Returns each match's title, description, genres, whether it plays on phones, whether people can play it together, play and upvote counts, the creator's X handle when known, and a link to its Foundplay page. Read-only. With no query, returns the most played games.

limit.description: How many games to return. Default 8.

multiplayer.description: true for games people play together, online or on one screen.

phone.description: true for games with touch controls that play on a phone.

query.description: Words to match, such as 'zombie shooter', 'racing', 'puzzle' or 'cozy farm'.

sort.description: popular (most played, the default), trending (last 48 hours) or new.

name: search_games

multiplayer.description: true: people play it together. false: single-player. null: not known.

phoneFriendly.description: true: plays on phones. false: needs a keyboard. null: not known.

url.description: The game's page on Foundplay, with a Play button.

total.description: How many games matched in all.

title: Search browser games
